question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Transient
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Transient"** means something that lasts for a short period of time; temporary. (अस्थायी)

 
 
• **Example: **The transient nature of youth is often a topic of philosophical discussions.
 
 
 
• **"Permanent"** refers to something that lasts for a very long time or forever; not temporary. (स्थायी)
 
 
• **Example: **He decided to make a permanent move to the new city for his job.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Transient'** is **'Permanent'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Transitory** (क्षणिक): Lasting for a very short time.

 
 
• **Example:** The transitory moments of joy were quickly overshadowed by the impending challenges.
 
 
 
• **Transparent** (पारदर्शी): Allowing light to pass through so that objects behind can be distinctly seen.
 
 
• **Example:** The transparent glass windows provided a clear view of the garden.
 
 
 
• **Irregular** (अनियमित): Not even or balanced in shape or arrangement.
 
 
• **Example:** His attendance in class has been very irregular this semester.
